title: docs: allow secret changes in feature PRs
author: voodoohop
pr_body_excerpt:
- Removes the rule requiring encrypted secret changes to use a dedicated PR
- Keeps explicit secret-mutation approval and production deployment safeguards unchanged

gist.headline: One less PR detour
gist.blurb: Feature PRs can include encrypted secret changes without taking a separate trip. Approval and production deployment safeguards stay put.
gist.summary: AGENTS.md no longer requires encrypted secret changes to use a dedicated PR, while explicit secret-mutation approval and production deployment safeguards remain unchanged.
gist.impact: Contributors can keep encrypted secret changes with the feature they support, subject to the same approval and deployment checks.
gist.visual_concept: Depict an internal contributor guide beside a feature PR containing a small locked secret file; Polli brings them together while an unchanged approval gate remains in view. Use a cozy garden workbench rather than implying a security issue or a user-facing feature.
gist.image_prompt: At a cozy pixel-art garden workbench, Polli clips a tiny locked file to a feature PR page while a friendly approval gate stands beside a flowering code-plant. The main character is a cute pixel art bee mascot with a yellow body and dark brown horizontal stripes, small black legs, two black antennae, black vertical oval eyes, bright pink rectangular blush marks on cheeks, a small happy smile, and small rounded light blue translucent wings; she wears tiny reading glasses and shares the frame with the workbench. Cozy pixel art, 8-bit aesthetic, soft pastel gradients, warm lighting, retro gaming vibes, with prominent lime green (#ecf874), warm cream, and dark purple (#110518) details.
